commands:
git fetch origin ed3980fcfdf263896a660d70696adbfd06c58bfe 2>&1 | tail -1
echo "=== docs/*.md refs at PR HEAD in shipped scripts/ + lib/ (excl lib/test, excl .example) ==="
for f in $(git ls-tree -r --name-only ed3980fcfdf263896a660d70696adbfd06c58bfe -- scripts/ lib/ | grep -vE '^lib/test/|\.example$'); do
  git show "ed3980fcfdf263896a660d70696adbfd06c58bfe:$f" 2>/dev/null | grep -nE 'docs/[a-zA-Z0-9_/.-]+' | sed "s|^|$f:|"

ls .prflow/prompt-extensions/*.md.example | sed 's|.*/||;s|.md.example||' | sort > /tmp/have; grep -vE '^\s*#|PE_SKILLS' scripts/scaffold-config.sh | sed -n '277,294p' 2>/dev/null; awk -F'|' '/^[a-z].*\|/{print $1}' scripts/scaffold-config.sh | sort > /tmp/want; echo "=== in generator not committed ==="; comm -23 /tmp/want /tmp/have; echo "=== committed not in generator ==="; comm -13 /tmp/want /tmp/have

cd /home/runner/work/prflow/prflow; comm -23 <(awk -F'|' '/^[a-z-]+\|/{print $1}' scripts/scaffold-config.sh | sort -u) <(ls .prflow/prompt-extensions/*.md.example | sed 's|.*/||;s|.md.example||' | sort -u); echo "---done---"
cd /home/runner/work/prflow/prflow; ls .prflow/prompt-extensions/*.md.example | wc -l; ls .prflow/prompt-extensions/*.md.example | sed 's|.*/||;s|\.md\.example||' | sort | tr '\n' ' '
